nodes.label: Factual
nodes.question: What intervention strategies may benefit the Waste Moderate group in adopting more sustainable behaviours?
nodes.answer: The Waste Moderate group, who have average and active environmental values, may benefit from citizen science campaigns, as these have been shown to increase willingness to adopt litter-reducing behaviours.

nodes.label: Factual
nodes.question: How do waste prevention behaviours vary among different megacity regions in Japan?
nodes.answer: Waste prevention behaviours can vary among different megacity regions in Japan due to local measures, socio-demographic factors, and cultural norms influencing individual attitudes and practices towards waste reduction and recycling.
